function.arguments: {"message":"You can verify the status of the report in Settings → Reports → Scheduled. The page shows each scheduled report and its recent run history. If the report is disabled, it will be marked as such. If it’s still enabled but not delivering, check the run history – a failed run will show a reason, often related to a bouncing recipient address. Meridian pauses delivery to bouncing emails while keeping the schedule active, which can make it look like the whole report stopped. Reviewing the run history will tell you whether the schedule is still configured or if delivery issues need to be addressed."}

arguments.message: You can verify the status of the report in Settings → Reports → Scheduled. The page shows each scheduled report and its recent run history. If the report is disabled, it will be marked as such. If it’s still enabled but not delivering, check the run history – a failed run will show a reason, often related to a bouncing recipient address. Meridian pauses delivery to bouncing emails while keeping the schedule active, which can make it look like the whole report stopped. Reviewing the run history will tell you whether the schedule is still configured or if delivery issues need to be addressed.
